value.name: SystemViews
value.description-key: SystemViews - Will have [ViewName]-{CRMID}-[View GUID] format to cope with views with same name

property.name: filterEntityFieldByEntitiesAssociatedTo
property.display-name-key: Filter Entity Field By Entities Associated To
property.description-key: Only applies if the AutoCompleteMetaDataType is set to Entity. It will filter entity field auto complete list By entities associated to entity entered in this property

property.name: relatedEntity
property.description-key: Only applies if the AutoCompleteMetaDataType is set to anything other than Entity. It will filter the autocomplete list to contain only metadata values related to this entity. Supports binding to the selectedValue output of another XrmMetadataAutoComplete control (e.g. an Entity picker).

property.name: searchPlaceholder
property.description-key: Placeholder text shown in the search box. Defaults to 'Search...' if not set.

property.name: noSuggestionsMessage
property.description-key: Message shown when the search returns no results. Defaults to 'No results found' if not set.

property.name: outputMode
property.description-key: Controls what value is stored in the bound field when an item is selected. LogicalName (default) stores the schema name (e.g. 'account') and is required when this control's output feeds another control's Related Entity. DisplayValue stores the full label as shown in the list (e.g. 'Account (account)').

value.name: LogicalName
value.description-key: Stores the logical/schema name. Use this when chaining controls.

value.name: DisplayValue
value.description-key: Stores the full display label as shown in the list. Do not use when this control feeds another control's Related Entity.
